rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before data; structural Amendment 0 and synthetic Amendment 1 before real data; real-skeleton synthetic (D size/power, kappa_R power, selection/field/mixture worlds); 5 replication units and 4 natives in two models, two variants and dedupe; estimates rows; confirm.py frozen with a passing dry run (not run). Missing: holdout run; statement-level switching dynamics; larger dose (NE42).
rationale.faithfulness: HH332 fails by its own kill rule: hoppers are not intermediate and there is no dose-response (powered at kappa >= 0.1). The domain half holds (D 5-6 where rooms do different work, both models), but that half replicates H47. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A clear design rule for room-based swarms: separate work makes separate content domains, and occasional visitors neither blend them nor carry content home; transfer needs posting or moving agents. Few hoppers limit the evidence.

one_line: Rooms with different work are two content domains with a sharp, empty wall; hoppers switch sides with the room they speak in and carry nothing home, so bridging agents do not widen the wall.

models.note: domains yes; hoppers not in the wall; no read dose
scalar wall coordinate bimodal; wall width zero

v2.claim: In #51g (the #focus weeks), room hoppers are not intermediate on the inter-domain axis and hopping read-outs do not move a hopper's home-room content: kappa_R -0.014 [-0.042, 0.024] per e-fold, excluding kappa >= 0.1 (synthetic power >= 0.93); the one frequent hopper sits at s 0.06 vs the stayers' p95 0.21. Excluded: small per-read pulls (kappa < 0.1, unpowered), selection vs coupling (not separable), the domain half (D 5.3-6.1; a separate positive clause, not scored here).
v2.scope: one powered unit (51g: one hopper with >= 5 hop-days, ~50 hopping read-outs); the negative is scoped to kappa >= 0.1 per e-fold of read-outs (rule 2)

adjudication.decision: Rule 1 requires a re-score. The coordinator's record scored a two-clause composite ('domains form' + 'no wall'). The claim that stands is the HH kill result (hoppers not intermediate; no dose response), so the coordinator re-scored that clause alone. Final credence is the log-odds mean of the re-score and blind_r3, as for any two raters (|dp| 0.08 < 0.25, no adjudication threshold crossed).
reasons: Rule 1: one clause. The domain half (D 5.3-6.1) is a separate positive result. Its 'replication of domains (G41, G42) x1.3' factor no longer applies to the scored clause.
Rules 2 and 3: the negative is stated at kappa >= 0.1 per e-fold, where power is >= 0.93. P2/P3's stated falsifier is what happened, so the primary base stays.
Rule 8: the 51g synthetic is one design. It is credited once as identification (x1.5), not also as a 'powered null' (the coordinator's extra x1.4).

The coordinator's 'kappa test liberal, fixed post hoc' penalty is withdrawn. Amendment 1 (alpha 0.01 + lag) was written before real data, and a liberal test that does not reject makes the negative conservative. The 'one frequent hopper' penalty is the single-unit factor (x0.6) and is not stacked on it.
The re-scored coordinator ladder gives 0.47 and blind_r3 gives 0.55; log-odds mean 0.51. V 1.5 (both raters).
